title: Native proper direct image preserves coproducts on the bounded constructible hull
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $\ell$ be prime with $\operatorname{char}k\ne\ell$, let $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a Noetherian scheme over $k$, and let $p:Z\to Y$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. On the small pro-etale site of each scheme T use the actual native locally finite coefficient ring $B_T$ and heart $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Let $\mathcal C_Z\subset D(\mathcal A_Z)$ be the bounded complexes with native constructible cohomology and let $\mathcal L_Z=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal C_Z)$ be their full replete localizing hull [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory, def-weil-size-convention]. For every indexing type I in Type (u+1), the functor $\mathcal L_Z\hookrightarrow D(\mathcal A_Z)\xrightarrow{R(p_*^{\mathrm{adic}})}D(\mathcal A_Y)$ preserves coproducts indexed by I. The total right derived functor is the ordinary native one; the assertion does not claim preservation on all ambient objects or membership of its outputs in a target hull. No absolute separatedness of Y or Z is assumed.

proof.text: Properness over Noetherian Y makes Z Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. Let E_Z and E_Y be the specified exact native encodings and their unbounded derived functors [lem-sf-native-adic-encoding-ordinary-operations]. Apply [lem-sf-native-adic-encoding-bounded-constructible] to the native bounded constructible generators. Since the derived equivalence is triangulated and preserves coproducts, ObjectProperty.localizingClosure_le_inverseImage carries the native hull into the condensed bounded constructible hull. Lift E_Z to these full subcategories; inclusion reflects colimits, so this lift preserves coproducts.

Apply [lem-sfb-proper-serre-heart-qbar] to aY and p. Use the proved source-library theorem ProperLowerStarHeartHypotheses.preservesColimitsOfShape in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ModuleObject.Derived.ProperLowerStarCoproducts to obtain coproduct preservation of the condensed proper direct image restricted to its bounded constructible hull. Compose with the lifted E_Z from step 1.

Whisker the specified NativeEncoding.derivedPushComparison by the native source-hull inclusion. It identifies the functor of step 2 with the native restricted proper direct image followed by E_Y. Equivalences reflect colimits, so reflection through E_Y proves the assertion for the original native right derived direct image, including the empty coproduct.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeAdicProper_preservesCoproducts
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : ringChar k ≠ l)
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p] (I : Type (u + 1)) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
      ((DerivedCategory.boundedAdicConstructible l Z).localizingClosure.ι ⋙
        (adicLowerStar l p).rightDerivedFunctor)
